name: Flypp
about: Flypp makes interactive decks, documents and calculators: screens with sliders, live formulas, tables, buttons and branches.

landmarks.name: Screens
landmarks.where: first button in the toolbar across the top
landmarks.what: the list of screens down the left side

landmarks.name: Insert
landmarks.where: toolbar across the top, next to Screens
landmarks.what: add text, images, sliders, charts and other elements

landmarks.name: Variables
landmarks.what: values that sliders and formulas share across screens

landmarks.name: Animations
landmarks.what: how elements and screens move in

landmarks.name: Themes
landmarks.what: fonts and colours for the whole deck

landmarks.name: Templates
landmarks.what: ready-made screens and decks to start from

landmarks.name: Live
landmarks.where: toolbar across the top, with a lock until you sign in

landmarks.name: Add a screen
landmarks.where: orange button at the bottom of the screen list on the left

landmarks.name: Map of screens
landmarks.where: under Add a screen, bottom left
landmarks.what: every screen and branch as a map

landmarks.name: Screen name
landmarks.where: right-hand panel when no element is selected

landmarks.name: Add a branch
landmarks.where: right-hand panel, under Where next goes

landmarks.name: Background
landmarks.where: top right of the toolbar row

landmarks.name: Size
landmarks.what: page shape, like 16:9 or Social post, tall (4:5)

landmarks.name: Move to fit
landmarks.where: tick box top right, next to Size

landmarks.name: File
landmarks.where: top bar, right side, near Sign in

landmarks.name: Light
landmarks.what: switch the editor to light mode

steps.do: Click Add a screen at the bottom of the list on the left
In the list on the left, click the copy icon to the right of the screen's thumbnail (the top of the two little icons)
In the list on the left, click the red bin icon to the right of the screen's thumbnail
Click an empty bit of the screen so nothing is selected
Type the new name in Screen name on the right

recipes.say: Branches let Next go somewhere other than the next screen.

steps.do: Click an empty bit of the screen so the screen's settings show on the right
Click Add a branch under Where next goes
Click Map of screens at the bottom left

recipes.say: File, Import, PowerPoint brings the slides in as screens.

steps.do: Open the File menu
Choose Import
Choose PowerPoint and pick your file
Click Insert in the toolbar along the top
Pick what you want to add
Click Insert in the toolbar along the top
Pick Slider
Link it to a variable in its settings on the right
Click Variables in the toolbar along the top
Select the element you want to animate
Click Animations in the toolbar
Click Themes in the toolbar
Click Templates in the toolbar
Open the Size dropdown at the top right and pick a shape
Click Background at the top right
Pick a spacing in the Grid dropdown at the top right
Click Preview at the top right
Click Present at the far top right

recipes.say: Live needs you signed in first.

steps.do: Click Sign in at the top
Then click Live in the toolbar
Click the deck name at the top left, next to the version tag (it has a little pencil)
Click Light at the bottom right
Open the Mode dropdown in the top bar and pick what you're making
Use the arrows either side of the screen number under the canvas, or click a screen in the list on the left

glossary.Screen: Flypp's word for a slide or page.
glossary.Branch: A rule that sends Next to a different screen, for choose-your-path decks.
glossary.Variable: A named value that sliders change and formulas use, shared across screens.
glossary.Map of screens: A bird's-eye view of every screen and the branches between them.
glossary.Live: Audience features like live questions; needs you signed in.
glossary.Move to fit: Keeps elements inside the page when you change its size.

tips: Got a PowerPoint already? File, Import, PowerPoint turns its slides into screens.
Name your screens on the right: branches and the map get much easier to read.
Map of screens, bottom left, shows every branch at once. Handy for checking dead ends.
Preview is the quick way to test branches and sliders without starting a full presentation.
Variables are shared across screens, so a slider on screen 1 can drive a chart on screen 5.
Changing Size with Move to fit ticked keeps everything on the page.
